name: wani_form_top2
desc: the top end of a thick pink and yellow marbled goo pillar. Round off the flat top edge only slightly into a low soft rounded top that is no wider than the pillar itself, like a melted candle top, with a couple of small bubbles and goo running down. No overhanging cap, do not make it taller. Keep the pillar width, colors, stripes and the lower part exactly the same. Same pixel art rendering as the reference.
